questions.prompt: Explain what the VIA Character Strengths survey measures and what you do with your results.
questions.modelAnswer: The VIA survey is a free online questionnaire from the VIA Institute on Character that ranks your 24 character strengths from strongest to weakest. You register a free account at viacharacter.org, complete the survey, then save your results and share the summary with your manager.
keyPoints: Register a free account at viacharacter.org
Share the results summary with your manager

questions.prompt: What are the four traits in the DISC assessment, and where do you take it?
questions.modelAnswer: DISC stands for Dominance, Influence, Steadiness and Conscientiousness. You take the free assessment at the Tony Robbins DISC link on the card (tonyrobbins.com/disc), read the DISC.pdf attached to the Trello card, and share your results with your manager.
keyPoints: Read the DISC.pdf attachment and share results with your manager
